He was sentenced to six months in prison in 2024, suspended for two years . C

items.title: ‘I’m no longer a UAE official’: UN hopeful Lana Nusseibeh tries to shake off Sudan record
items.summary: The US and Russia’s candidate for secretary general is on a charm offensive. Can she overcome London’s resistance to her bid? Lana Nusseibeh is in Britain this week, attempting to present herself as a potential future UN secretary general, and shift the focus from her past as a United Arab Emirates diplomat who denied the country’s role in arming a militia accused of war crimes and genocide in Sudan’s four-year civil war. It is a high-risk strategy that involves meeting ministers, MPs, academics and holding a public event with the UN Association. Continue reading...
